title: Women's Golden Retriever – I Brought You a Sock Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Golden Retriever Zip Up Hoodie – I Brought You a Sock
seo.description: A golden retriever zip up hoodie: I BROUGHT YOU A SOCK. YOU'RE WELCOME. on the back over a retriever and flowers, plus an embroidered retriever on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This golden retriever zip up hoodie is for the woman whose retriever greets her at the door with a sock and a wagging tail, zipped on for the dog park and the walk home.

A golden retriever bounds forward with a striped sock in its mouth through a wreath of poppies, daisies, ferns and wildflowers, in orange, red, sage, mustard and cream with a worn print texture. I BROUGHT YOU A SOCK. runs above it and YOU'RE WELCOME. below in heavy slab capitals, the second block a touch wider than the first: orange and cream on Black and Navy, rust and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small golden retriever head holding a striped sock is embroidered on the left chest, and the word SOCK is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest retriever and sock and left-cuff SOCK, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the I Brought You a Sock zip hoodie fit?
The I Brought You a Sock golden retriever zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this golden retriever hoodie warm enough for chilly dog walks?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles chilly dog walks, damp dog parks and the drive home with a wet dog well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, I BROUGHT YOU A SOCK. above the dog and YOU'RE WELCOME. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small golden retriever head holding a striped sock sits on the left chest with no words, and SOCK is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The retriever and sock on the chest and the SOCK cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a dog lover, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend whose retriever has never once come home empty-mouthed. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
